confidence_note: Miller's StoryBrand 7-part framework (SB7) is the core of the book: a Character who wants something encounters a Problem, meets a Guide who understands their fear, gives them a Plan, Calls them to action, which helps them avoid Failure and ends in Success. He calls the resulting message a BrandScript, and repeatedly stresses that if you confuse, you'll lose: customers won't spend energy trying to understand an unclear message. Details paraphrased.
facts: Miller argues that most marketing fails because it is confusing: companies say too much, in too complicated a way.
His rule: 'If you confuse, you'll lose.' Customers won't burn mental energy figuring out what you offer.

He proposes a seven-part story framework (SB7): a Character (the customer) wants something; they have a Problem; they meet a Guide (the brand); who gives them a Plan; and Calls them to action; that helps them avoid Failure; and ends in Success.
The Problem has external, internal and philosophical levels; companies often address only the external one, while customers buy solutions to internal frustrations.
A clear Plan, often just a few simple steps, reduces customers' fear of taking action.
The completed framework, which he calls a BrandScript, guides a company's website, emails and pitches.
tension: Companies with good products lose to competitors with clearer messages.
opening_idea: A customer lands on a website and has about five seconds to understand what it offers. Most sites fail the test.

lessons.idea: Tell a simple story with the customer at the center.
Address the internal problem, not just the external one.

reflect: Could a stranger explain what you offer after five seconds?
What internal problem does your work actually solve?
reflect_final: How would your message read if you wrote it as a simple seven-part story?

use_cases.situation: Your website is full of features and jargon.
use_cases.move: Rewrite the top section as problem, plan and success in three sentences.

use_cases.situation: You struggle to explain your freelance services.
use_cases.move: Write your one-paragraph BrandScript: the client, their problem, your plan, their success.

use_cases.situation: A friend's startup pitch confuses investors.
use_cases.move: Help them tell it as a simple story about one customer's problem and success.

pocket_idea: If you confuse, you'll lose; tell a simple story instead.

conversation_variants.punchline_idea: Great products lose to clear messages.
